reason: A local coverage-report analysis plugin that parses several standard formats and identifies low-coverage files and uncovered line ranges; the README states it does not run tests or use shell, network, or external services.

summaries.zh: 解析多种代码覆盖率报告，输出总体与逐文件覆盖率，并定位指定文件的未覆盖行区间。
summaries.en: Parses common code coverage reports, summarizes overall and per-file coverage, and locates uncovered line ranges in selected files.

capabilities: Parses LCOV, Cobertura, Istanbul, Vitest, Jest, and Go coverage formats
Reports aggregate and per-file coverage metrics
Identifies uncovered line ranges for specified files
